translation.app_tagline: Radar sees the flood through the clouds

methods.title: Methods
methods.step1: 1. Select two Sentinel-1 derived water masks (OPERA DSWx-S1)
methods.step2: 2. Read open-water class from both periods
methods.step3: 3. New flood = water after AND NOT water before
methods.note: Note: SAR water detection can be affected by dense vegetation, wind roughening, and urban layover.

footer.credits: Data: NASA Earthdata, ASF DAAC, Sentinel-1/ESA Copernicus, OPERA.
